## alice-dms-thumbnailer-backfill

One-time manual backfill: generates thumbnails for all Weaviate documents
that don't have a thumbnail_path set yet.

**Trigger**: POST /webhook/alice/dms/thumb-backfill
**Processes**: Invoice, BankStatement, BankTransaction, Document, Email, SecuritySettlement, Contract, Image
**Progress**: logged as { processed, failed, skipped_already_has_thumb, remaining }
**Safe to re-run**: skips documents that already have thumbnail_path
